integrity: All proof and verification files are embedded with literal contents and byte hashes; no external code dependencies beyond Python 3 standard library.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field rank-one square-zero induced commuting graph only; full matrix rings and higher ranks excluded. Earlier equivalent clique classifications remain possible, particularly the incompletely accessed 2014 orthogonality-graph paper. Full-priority verification and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Maximal mutual-annihilation cliques and the complete clique polynomial of rank-one square-zero matrices
